questionText:

"International trade is the exchange of goods and services among countries across international borders. After the Second World War, the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) was formed in 1948 to reduce tariffs and trade barriers. On 1 January 1995, GATT was transformed into the World Trade Organization (WTO), headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
